historical_key.identity: Gabriel de Lavinde manual, separately headed unnumbered [Anonym.] nomenclator placed after no. 28
historical_key.date: 1379 manual stratum; anonymous table not separately dated
historical_key.archive_shelfmark: Archivio Apostolico Vaticano (Meister: Vat. Arch.), Collect. 393, ff. 166-181
historical_key.independence_warning: Meister footnotes the table as very similar to no. 13; rows must not be counted as independent cumulative support.

source_object.citation: Aloys Meister, Die Geheimschrift im Dienste der päpstlichen Kurie von ihren Anfängen bis zum Ende des XVI. Jahrhunderts (Paderborn: Ferdinand Schöningh, 1906)

admission_rule: All and only source-first, fully printed entry-code pairs whose codes are unambiguous Roman letters and/or Arabic digit 3; no target comparison and no graphic-sign reconstruction.
excluded_controls: Karolus de la pace: supraline or overbarred b-like code
Comes fundorum: letter plus graphic stroke
Matrimonium: typographically l/I-like first code character
